how_to_revise: Edit this file (config/reviewer-policy.json), raise the version, set status to APPROVED when the owner signs it off, commit and deploy. The page at /review/policy reads it; nothing else needs changing. Numbers marked owner_set are decisions of the owner and are shown as 'not set' until a value is entered.

sections.title: Who can review
sections.summary: A reviewer must be verified and active and hold a granted domain for the subject, grade and market of each question.

rules.text: Reviewer status is verified and the profile is active.
A domain is granted for the question's subject, grade and market (subject spelled exactly as in the curriculum, for example Computing, FRENCH).
Nobody reviews a question they wrote or one from their own school.
Senior QA reviews are done by a different person from the primary reviewer of the same question.

sections.title: Workload
sections.summary: Limits are admin settings, not fixed in code (decision D-12).

rules.text: Maximum reviews per reviewer per day.
Questions taken in one pick.
An unfinished pick returns to the pool after this time, with no pay.
Target open queue per reviewer.
Maximum open queue per reviewer.

sections.title: Pay
sections.summary: Fees come from the compensation policy and are pinned when a question is picked (decision D-11).

rules.text: Currency.
Base fee per completed review.
Additional fee when the review approves the question.
A review reversed by senior QA earns nothing.
Earnings move through pending QA, payable and paid; payouts are approved in batches.

sections.title: Quality control
sections.summary: Paid work is sampled so that speed never replaces care.

rules.text: Share of each reviewer's completed reviews sampled by senior QA.
Minimum time on a question before a decision counts.
Known-faulty questions are mixed in; approving one is a quality flag.
A reviewer whose reversal rate passes the set threshold is paused until a senior reviews their work.
Rejected or revised questions carry a written reason the author can act on.
Super admins manage markets, currencies, compensation and capabilities.
Reviewer support (capability sme_support) onboards reviewers and grants domains only; it cannot change pay, markets or capabilities.
Every grant, pick, decision and payout step is recorded with who and when.
